text:
Asking rents in Bocholt stand at a median of 10.00 €/m² (2026-06), up 2.8% on the year and +23.9% over five years. That ranks Bocholt #23 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 60% above the 2022 average contract rent of 6.26 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 600 € a month in cold rent, 12.3% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 30 days and 20% are gone within a week; with 1.5% market-active vacancy and +2.7% population growth over five years, the market looks tight.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 10.38 €/m² (+3.8%), with an 80% range of 10.05 to 10.78 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
